utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. For the Prosecution, Douglas Stringer, Matthew Gillett, Case Manager Thomas Laugel, and legal intern Lucia Laporte.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence, Mr. Zivanovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic, Christopher Gosnell, and legal intern Andrew Seaton. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. A short oral ruling. The Trial Chamber is seized of the Prosecution motion for the substitution of Rule 65 ter document 03110, filed on the 21st of June. Has the Defence a position on this --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: No position. Thank you. The motion is granted. The Prosecution is allowed to substitute 65 ter document 03110 as requested and the Prosecution is to notify the Chamber, the Defence, and the Registrar once it has done so. We have a closed session witness today for the entire hearing. Can we go into closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: We had budgeted the remainder of today for the witness's cross-examination. I've just been sending e-mails, seeing that we were winding down, and I'm being told that he is not ready for today. He is here. I believe he has been proofed or was almost finished being proofed. But, at this moment, Mr. President, I'm not able to say that the witness is in the room and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: You mean for the remainder of the day or you mean just -- just right now? I mean, we could eventually take a break and see whether we can start with him at -- at 12.00, for instance, or 12.15. But if you say that he is not really ready and available, then we'll start tomorrow at 9.00.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: I think that I would be better, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 25th day of June, 2013, at 9.00 a.m. 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 11.22 a.m.,
